input_data.description: The list of lines to present in the iSelect interface.

title.description: Sets the file ..., displayed centered at the bottom of the browser window (-t).

name.description: Changes the string displayed flush left at the bottom of the browser window from 'iSelect' (-n).

force_browse.description: Open the full-screen browser even if input contains less than 2 lines (-f).

allow_all_select.description: Force all lines to be selectable, '<s>' tags are still removed (-a).

exit_no_select.description: Exit immediately if no lines are selectable (-e).

multi_line.description: Allow selecting more than one line with Space (-m).

strip_result.description: Strip all leading and trailing whitespace from the result string (-S).

key_result.description: Prefix each result with the key used to confirm the selection (-K).

position_result.description: Prefix each result with its 1-based line number in the buffer (-P).

quit_result.description: Write fallback to the standard output stream when quitting (-Q).

delimiter_beg.description: Beginning delimiter for selection tags (part of -d).

delimiter_end.description: Ending delimiter for selection tags (part of -d).

position.description: Sets the cursor position to 1-based linenumber (-p). 0 means default.

key_mappings.description: List of key mappings to apply via -k flag. Each item is a flat map with 'key' and optionally 'output_key'. If output_key is empty, defaults to RETURN.
